title: FlowDoc Design Workspace Usability
summary: Recover the Editor-owned Design workspace usability work onto the canonical flowdoc-vnext-editor repository after PLAN found the 2026-09-03 accepted Editor commits were produced in the old FlowDocEditor repository.
